product_overview: GalaxyNutrition is a bilingual nutrition tracking web app that helps users set up their profile, track meals and exercise, and monitor progress through dashboards and analytics. It also offers AI-powered meal scanning and personalized nutrition plan generation.
core_goals: Create an account and complete first-time profile setup
Track daily food intake by logging meals manually or from food photos
Monitor calories, macros, weight, BMI, and water intake from the dashboard
Generate and review personalized nutrition plans
Log workouts and estimate calories burned
Review trends in weight, calories, and macros over time
Update profile preferences, language, and theme settings

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Users can create an account and sign in with email and password.
user_flows: Navigate to /register -> Fill in name -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Fill in confirm password -> Submit registration form -> See account created
Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> See dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> See invalid credentials message
Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Toggle password visibility -> Submit login form -> See dashboard

features.name: Onboarding Wizard
features.description: New users complete a seven-step setup to save profile details and calculate daily nutrition targets.
user_flows: Navigate to /onboarding -> Enter name and age -> Select gender -> Enter height, current weight, and target weight -> Select activity level -> Select goal -> Select diet type -> Review calculated macro summary -> Complete setup -> See saved profile

Navigate to /onboarding -> Enter profile details across the wizard -> Review calculated macro summary -> Go back and change goal or diet type -> Review updated macro summary -> Complete setup -> See saved profile

features.name: Dashboard Overview
features.description: Users can view daily nutrition progress and quickly add food, water, and weight updates from the main dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View calorie ring, macro progress, BMI indicator, weight mini chart, water tracker, and AI coach tips
Navigate to / -> Search for food -> Select a food item -> Add it to today's log -> See the dashboard nutrition totals update
Navigate to / -> Open the food entry flow -> Enter a meal -> Save the entry -> See the meal appear in today's list
Navigate to / -> Add a weight entry -> See the weight mini chart update
Navigate to / -> Tap a water amount -> See water intake update
Navigate to / -> Delete a meal entry from today's list -> See the dashboard totals change

features.name: Meal Log
features.description: Users can review today's meals grouped by meal type and manage food entries.
user_flows: Navigate to /log -> View today's calorie and macro summary -> Review meals grouped by breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snack
Navigate to /log -> Open the food entry flow -> Enter a meal -> Save the entry -> See the meal added to the correct meal group
Navigate to /log -> Delete a food entry -> See the meal removed from today's list

features.name: AI Food Scanner
features.description: Users can upload or capture a meal photo and get detected foods with estimated nutrition before adding selected items to the log.
user_flows: Navigate to /scan -> Upload a meal photo -> View detected food items with estimated weight and nutrition -> Select foods to add -> Add selected items to the log -> See the entries recorded
Navigate to /scan -> Capture a meal photo -> View detected food items with estimated weight and nutrition -> Select foods to add -> Add selected items to the log -> See the entries recorded

features.name: AI Nutrition Plan Generator
features.description: Users can generate a personalized nutrition plan from their profile and save or manage generated plans.
user_flows: Navigate to /plans -> View profile summary card -> Generate a nutrition plan -> Watch the plan stream in real time -> Show daily targets -> View the meal macro table
Navigate to /plans -> View saved plans -> Expand a saved plan -> Collapse the saved plan
Navigate to /plans -> View saved plans -> Delete a saved plan

features.name: Workout Tracker
features.description: Users can log exercises, estimate calories burned, and manage today's workout entries.
user_flows: Navigate to /workout -> Search for an exercise -> Select an exercise from the catalog -> Adjust duration -> Calculate calories burned -> Add the exercise to the log -> See today's workout entry
Navigate to /workout -> Type a custom exercise name -> Calculate calories burned -> Edit the calorie value -> Add the exercise to the log -> See today's workout entry
Navigate to /workout -> Delete an exercise from today's list -> See the workout entry removed

features.name: Analytics
features.description: Users can review trends in weight, calories, and macro distribution over time.
user_flows: Navigate to /analytics -> View weight history, daily calorie, and macro distribution charts
Navigate to /analytics -> Toggle the time range to 7 days -> Review updated chart ranges
Navigate to /analytics -> Toggle the time range to 30 days -> Review updated chart ranges

features.name: Settings
features.description: Users can update profile details, language, theme, and account preferences.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings -> Edit name, current weight, goal, and diet type -> Save changes -> See updated profile settings
Navigate to /settings -> Toggle language between Arabic and English -> Save changes -> See the interface language update
Navigate to /settings -> Toggle theme between dark and light -> Save changes -> See the interface theme update
Navigate to /settings -> Choose to delete the account -> Confirm deletion -> See the account removed

tech_stack.other: Supabase (PostgreSQL + Auth), OpenRouter AI, Recharts, Lucide React

routes.description: Main dashboard with calorie ring, macro bars, BMI, weight chart, water tracker, AI coach, and meal list
7-step first-time setup wizard to collect user profile data
Daily meal log grouped by meal type with add and delete functionality
AI food photo scanner using Gemini 2.0 Flash via camera or file upload
Generate AI nutrition plans via GPT-4o-mini streaming and view saved plans
Charts for weight history, daily calorie trend, and macro distribution
Exercise tracker with calorie burn calculation using MET values and AI
Edit profile, weight, goal, diet type, language, and theme

known_limitations.issue: Workout log is stored in localStorage only, not persisted to Supabase
known_limitations.impact: Workout history resets each new day and is not synced across devices

known_limitations.issue: Food database search is offline-only using local foodDatabase.ts
known_limitations.impact: Limited food catalog, no real-time nutritional database lookup

known_limitations.issue: AI food scan requires image upload, no live camera stream on desktop
known_limitations.impact: Desktop users must upload a file instead of using live camera
